items.summary: Recommendation: maintain the evidence-needed security disposition and private launch gates. Continue authorized read-only evidence capture only; access boundaries, secrets, isolation, release, dependency, monitoring, incident, TLS, and disclosure controls remain unverified. No public exposure, credentials, permissions, dependencies, deployment, or external outreach is authorized.

Disposition: evidence_needed for fleet-wide security clearance; blocked for security-sensitive public exposure; conditional for ordinary reversible growth. Evidence: fleet-doctor has no run or results; operations deploy, uptime, and error sweeps are unavailable; authentication boundaries, secrets handling, container isolation, release controls, dependency provenance, data exposure, monitoring, incident response, TLS coverage, and security.txt/disclosure readiness remain unverified. No certificates are reported expiring within 30 days, but this does not establish complete TLS posture. Compliance is a technical baseline only: 37 pass, 16 fail, and 6 unknown. Retained worker and reviewer failures are containment signals, not proof of compromise. Risk severity is high for public exposure and security-sensitive release, medium for bounded growth. Exact decision: maintain private launch gates, continue bounded read-only security evidence capture, and permit only reversible growth that adds no credentials, permissions, dependencies, data collection, or cross-site behavior. Do not retrieve credentials, access private containers, exploit targets, change permissions, modify production, deploy, or conduct external outreach.

Continue existing bounded read-only security evidence work only. Record dated evidence, owners, affected scope, explicit unknowns, severity, and release implications for authentication and access boundaries, secret handling, runtime isolation, build and deployment provenance, dependency and supply-chain controls, TLS, data flows, monitoring, incident handling, and disclosure readiness. Do not create duplicate telemetry requests or new production work.
